mapper.insert: INSERT INTO baseline_rule (rule_code, rule_name, category, description, severity, score, level, asset_type, os_type, check_method, check_script, remediation_type, remediation_script, version, is_mandatory, enabled, status, protection_level_flag, group_combine_logic) VALUES (#{ruleCode}, #{ruleName}, #{category}, #{description}, #{severity}, #{score}, COALESCE(#{level}, 3), COALESCE(#{assetType}, 'OS'), #{osType}, #{checkMethod}, #{checkScript}, #{remediationType}, #{remediationScript}, #{version}, #{isMandatory}, #{enabled}, #{status}, #{protectionLevelFlag}, COALESCE(#{groupCombineLogic}, 'AND'))
